video.description:
🙏 Are you believing God for a new beginning, divine favor, and a powerful breakthrough? Join this powerful prayer inspired by the biblical prayer of Jabez in 1 Chronicles 4:10. 📖🔥 This Christian prayer encourages you to seek God’s blessings, ask Him to enlarge your territory, and trust Him to guide your steps toward a better future. ❤️🙌 Through faith in Jesus Christ, bring your struggles, dreams, and challenges before God and ask for wisdom, strength, protection, and new opportunities. 🕊️✨

🙏 Pray for a positive change in your life
🔥 Seek divine favor and breakthrough
🛡️ Ask God for protection and guidance
🌟 Pray for open doors and new opportunities
📖 Strengthen your faith through the Word of God

Make this powerful Jabez prayer part of your daily devotion and trust God with your future. 🙌❤️

🔔 Subscribe to Grace & Glory Prayers for powerful Christian prayers, daily devotionals, Bible-based encouragement, and faith-building messages.

transcript.text: The God of heaven has brought you into this atmosphere for a divine encounter.
Tonight is not an ordinary gathering, it is a prophetic appointment with destiny.
Hear the word of the Lord in 1 Chronicles 4:9-10:
And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.

And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me!
And God granted him that which he requested.
Child of God, listen carefully.
Jabez's life began with pain, sorrow, limitation, and reproach.
His name itself carried a prophecy of pain.
But one encounter with the God of Israel shifted the trajectory of his destiny.
The scripture says, And God granted him that which he requested.
Hear me, in the same way, your story is about to change tonight.
That which has followed you from birth, that which has followed you from your family line, that which has mocked your prayers and resisted your lifting, it is coming to an end in the name of Jesus.
I prophesy over you, every negative identity placed upon you is torn away.
Every name you were given by pain, by failure, by defeat, by delay, I cancel it by the blood of Jesus.
You will not longer be identified by sorrow, you will no longer be defined by failure.
The God of Jabez will give you a new name, a new identity, a new destiny.
Isaiah 62:2 declares, And thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the Lord shall name.
May that new name rest upon you tonight.
I decree and declare, let there be enlargement.
The same God who enlarged the coast of Jabez, enlarge your borders, expand your influence, multiply your opportunities, increase your resources.
I command enlargement in your finances, enlargement in your family.
Now I decree by the authority of scripture, every curse over your life is broken.
Every altar speaking against your destiny collapse by fire.
Every arrow fired against your progress return to sender.
Every chain tying you down break now.
Every embargo placed on your destiny scatter.
Every monitoring spirit be blinded.
Every gate of brass and bar of iron be caught asunder.
Psalm 30:11 says, Thou has turned for me my morning into dancing, thou has put off my sackcloth and girded me with gladness.
I prophesy this word over you tonight.

transcript.text: Someone under the sound of my voice, your story has been one of near success syndrome.
Getting close to breakthrough and suddenly it slips away.
But tonight I stand in the name of Jesus and I break that cycle.
That cycle of almost there but never there, I scatter it now.
That spirit of delay, go!
That spirit of disappointment, leave!
That altar of rejection, catch fire!
Your story is turning around now.
And I prophesy enlargement upon your life.
Jabez cried, 'Oh that you would enlarge my coast!'
I decree enlargement over your family.
Receive children! Receive fruitfulness! Receive joy!
Enlargement over your finances.
Step into new contracts, new clients, new streams of income.
Enlargement over your career, promotion, visibility, relevance.
Enlargement over your ministry, more influence, more anointing, more impact.
Psalm 115 verse 14 says, 'The Lord shall increase you more and more, you and your children.'
I decree this scripture fulfilled in your life.
Beloved, lift your right hand and declare with me:
'I decree and declare my story is turning around.
I will not die in sorrow.
I will not end in failure.
I am enlarged on every side.
My family is blessed.
My hands are blessed.
My head is lifted.
My coast is enlarged.
My life will glorify God.'
Thus sayeth the Spirit of God:
'There is someone listening to me, you have been praying secretly: Lord, why is my life like this? Why is my case different?'
The Lord says, 'I have heard your cry tonight, and before this week is over, I will surprise you.'
Expect sudden divine intervention!
Expect a phone call of good news!
Expect supernatural favor!
Expect restoration of what was lost!
Father, we exalt You for what You are doing.
You are the God who takes men from sorrow to joy, from shame to honor, from smallness to enlargement.
I decree and declare: every arrow fired against you to grieve you, to bring you into sorrow, to break your faith, is returned back to sender in the name of Jesus!
Psalm 7:15-16 says, 'He made a pit and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made. His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.'
Every trap set for you this week, the enemy will fall into it!
Every pit dug for you, your adversaries will be buried in it!
Every incantation raised against you, let it backfire!
Every voice of accusation, be silenced forever!
Someone under the sound of my voice, there is a repeated cycle of loss.
You rise and suddenly something pulls you down.
Tonight, by the power of the God of Jabez, that cycle is broken!
That spirit of rise and fall, scatter by fire!
That altar of sudden disappointment, collapse now!
Now I decree stability into your destiny.
I decree establishment into your career.
I decree fruitfulness into your family.
You will no longer sow and another reap.
You will no longer build and another inhabit.
You will no longer labor and be empty-handed.
Now hear me: the God of Jabez turned his reproach into honor.
I prophesy over you: honor in your business, honor in your workplace, honor in your ministry.
May your name be spoken with respect!
May your name be associated with favor!
May your name be remembered for good as Mordecai was remembered in the palace, so shall you be remembered this week!
Let every spirit of dishonor and mockery be reversed!
Psalm 30:11 declares, 'Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness.'
Your mourning is turned into dancing tonight!
Lift your hands and make these decrees with faith:
'I decree and declare that my story is turning around.
I will not be a victim of sorrow!'
Father, we glorify You.

But tonight that siege is broken.
